tags.Companion: Sahabi/Sahabiyya: a Muslim who met the Prophet ﷺ in his lifetime and died a Muslim. Only people the classical registers place in the confirmed sections are labelled Companion here.
tags.Successor (did not meet the Prophet): Lived in the Prophet's era or just after but is not recorded as having met him (al-Isaba sections 3–4, 'mukhadram', 'idrak'). Not counted as a Companion.
tags.Tabi'i: Successor: met one or more Companions but not the Prophet ﷺ.
tags.Taba' Tabi'i: Follower of the Successors: the third generation of transmitters.
tags.3rd Century AH: Transmitters active in the 200s AH, the generation of the great hadith compilers.
tags.Hadith narrator: Appears in the chain of transmission (isnad) of at least one hadith in the collections held by this app, or in the classical narrator registers.
tags.Tier A: Core figure with a full curated profile: biography, dates, relations, books and journeys where available.
tags.Tier B: Linked narrator: appears in the chain or as the 'narrated by' name of hadith held in this app, so their narrations are cross-tagged and can be opened.
tags.Tier C: Register narrator: listed in the classical narrator registers, but none of their hadith appear in the 39 collections held here. Biography may be sourced or auto-generated.
tags.(name only): The classical registers give a single name with no lineage, tribe or town. Kept for completeness but hidden from the Timeline list.
tags.Estimated date: Marked △ or 'c.': no recorded year survives; the year is placed from the generation label, from an event the person died at, or from the people around them in the chains.
tags.Died at: <event>: The source records death at a battle or event; the event's year is used. Where sources disagree, the later date is used and the earlier account is noted.
